sentences.text:
Saj Food Products Private Limited vs State Of West Bengal &
Ors on 14 May, 2025

Author: Amrita Sinha
Bench: Amrita Sinha
14.05.2025
 M/L 219
 Ct No. 14
 Sg Wpa 4343 of 2025
 Saj Food Products Private Limited
 Vs
 State of West Bengal & Ors.
 Mr. Abhratosh Majumdar, Sr. Adv.
 Mr. Sayan Sinha,
 Mr. Kausheyo Roy,
 Mr. Adil Naser,
 Mr. Nilanjan Bhattacharya
 ...for the petitioner
 Mr. Amit Mehoria,
 Ms. T. Singh,
 Ms. P. Banerjee,
 Mr. S. Dey.
 ...for respondent nos. 4 & 5
Mr. Nilotpal Chatterjee, Ms. Munmum Ganguly.
...for the State respondent Mr. Soumen Bhattacharya, Mr. Anindya Kanan, Mr. Aayush Sharma.
...for the Uoi
1. Supplementary affidavit and affidavit-of-service are taken on record.

2.  The petitioner is aggrieved by the prohibition order passed under Section 36(3)(B) of Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 dated 17.01.2025 issued by the District Food Safety Inspecting Officer &
Designated Officer (FSSAI) Murshidabad.

entities.text:
District Food Safety Inspecting Officer &
Designated Officer (FSSAI)
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. The biscuit under the brand name 'GOOGLY' has been prohibited to be manufactured or sold in the open market for being unsafe for human consumption.

4. In respect of the same food sample, an order was passed by the Court in WPA 1887 of 2025,
wherein, relying upon the report from the National Food Laboratory, similar prohibitory order was Saj Food Products Private Limited vs State Of West Bengal & Ors on 14 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109867353/
1 set aside.

entities.text: Saj Food Products Private Limited vs State Of West Bengal & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. As the food sample in respect of the earlier writ petition being 1887 of 2025 and the instant writ petition is the same, accordingly, the impugned prohibition order is directed to be kept in abeyance until further order of Court.
6. The respondent nos. 9 and 10 are directed to revert by filing their affidavits by 20.06.2025; reply thereto, if any, by 30.06.2025.

7. Liberty to mention the writ petition for final hearing after conclusion of the aforesaid time period.
8.
The respondents are restrained from issuing any further prohibition order in respect of the self- same food product without leave of the Court.
9. All parties are to act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Amrita Sinha, J.)

opennyai_summary.facts:
2.  The petitioner is aggrieved by the prohibition order passed under Section 36(3)(B) of Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 dated 17.01.2025 issued by the District Food Safety Inspecting Officer &
Designated Officer (FSSAI) Murshidabad.
3. The biscuit under the brand name 'GOOGLY' has been prohibited to be manufactured or sold in the open market for being unsafe for human consumption.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
4. In respect of the same food sample, an order was passed by the Court in WPA 1887 of 2025,
wherein, relying upon the report from the National Food Laboratory, similar prohibitory order was Saj Food Products Private Limited vs State Of West Bengal & Ors on 14 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109867353/
1 set aside.
opennyai_summary.decision:
5. As the food sample in respect of the earlier writ petition being 1887 of 2025 and the instant writ petition is the same, accordingly, the impugned prohibition order is directed to be kept in abeyance until further order of Court.
6. The respondent nos. 9 and 10 are directed to revert by filing their affidavits by 20.06.2025; reply thereto, if any, by 30.06.2025.
7. Liberty to mention the writ petition for final hearing after conclusion of the aforesaid time period.
8.
The respondents are restrained from issuing any further prohibition order in respect of the self- same food product without leave of the Court.
9. All parties are to act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
